falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom saw lower highs for 3 weeks; an immediate breakout to new highs breaks the structural similarity and proves this is not a comparable accumulation phase

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression into pre-August complacency levels would invalidate the bottom pattern, as the August 2024 low featured VIX remaining elevated (16-20) for weeks post-bottom; this signals the 'blowoff score' of 40 was actually a local minimum, not a developing top

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would invalidate the verdict because the August 2024 bottom coincided with yields rising (growth scare resolving into reflation); a sharp rally in bonds/decline in yields would confirm a deflationary liquidation rather than the pattern-matched cyclical bottom, proving the HOLD signal was wrong

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
